description: Answer exposure questions in one query via semantic AI search (degrading to TEXT) plus structured filters (--ecosystem / --vulnerable-only / --name).

requirements.title: AI search with TEXT fallback
requirements.description: SearchService.Search must embed the query via Ollama and rank Qdrant matches when both resources are available, and fall back to substring/keyword TEXT search when either is down; Status must report resource availability, indexed count, and last reconcile time.

validation.notes: With embedder+vectorstore available, Search returns AI-mode ranked results.
With Qdrant unavailable, Search degrades to TEXT mode without error.
Status reports indexed count and last reconcile timestamp.

requirements.title: Structured exposure filters
requirements.description: `deps search` must support --ecosystem, --vulnerable-only, and --name <glob> so 'which scenarios use vulnerable golang.org/x/net?' is a one-line query.

validation.notes: deps search --vulnerable-only returns only records with non-empty vuln_ids.
deps search --name 'golang.org/x/*' --vulnerable-only lists the affected scenarios.
